title: Four Dollars Seventy-Three
lyrics:
[Intro]
Your available balance is:
Four dollars...
and seventy-three cents.
[Pause]
Nice.
[Beat enters]
[Verse 1]
Four seventy-three and the tank says E
Payday Friday, today Tuesday
Coffee in the cup
Two smokes in the pack
Twenty-dollar bill that I wish I had back
Everybody online getting rich overnight
Meanwhile I'm calculating groceries under fluorescent lights
Bread
Milk
Eggs
Put the chips back
Maybe next week
If the hydro don't attack
Funny how money disappears like smoke
One minute you're alright
Next minute you're broke
But I still got dinner
Still got somewhere to sleep
And four dollars seventy-three
Belonging entirely to me
[Hook]
Four dollars seventy-three
Ain't much money
But it's mine and it's free
World keeps charging admission to breathe
I got four dollars seventy-three
[Verse 2]
Bank sends a message:
“Brad, we can help!”
Yeah?
Where were you yesterday
When my card declined itself?
Subscription I forgot about hit at three
Some app I haven't opened since 2023
Cancel.
Cancel.
Cancel that shit.
Apparently adulthood's mostly passwords and bills
Insurance
Internet
Phone
Gas
Every company got their hand in my ass
[Beat cuts]
Financially speaking.
[Beat resumes]
[Hook]
Four dollars seventy-three
Ain't much money
But it's mine and it's free
World keeps charging admission to breathe
I got four dollars seventy-three
[Jazz Break]
[Upright bass solo]
[Saxophone enters]
[Verse 3]
Then my kid laughs from the other room
Dog starts barking at the fucking moon
Dinner smells good
Someone I love says my name
Suddenly broke doesn't feel quite the same
Maybe wealth ain't numbers sitting inside an app
Maybe sometimes it's knowing exactly what you have
Still—
I'd like some money.
Let's not get philosophical.
Four seventy-three is objectively terrible.
[Bridge]
But tomorrow I'll work
Friday gets paid
Some goes forward
Some gets saved
Some disappears before I blink
And I'll probably buy coffee
Because I refuse instant drink
[Final Hook]
Four dollars seventy-three
Not my future
Just tonight's reality
World keeps charging admission to breathe
Tonight I'm worth more
Than four seventy-three.
[Outro]
[Phone notification]
LOW BALANCE ALERT.
Yeah.
I know.

treatment:
# Four Dollars Seventy-Three — approved treatment

Approved in chat November 8, 2026. Format: 1920 × 1080, 24 fps, full supplied recording. No artist branding. Profanity retained.

A dry, cinematic jazz-finance film: ink-black, receipt cream, muted bank green, with amber warmth arriving during the family verse. Hand-built vector environments, quiet parallax, precise word emphasis and controlled camera movement keep the humor readable.

- Intro: a bank balance display establishes the number and deadpan pause.
- Verse 1: fluorescent perspective grocery shelves and receipt details; the money metaphor appears in restrained graphic light fields.
- Hooks: oversized editorial type and engraved concentric currency circles.
- Verse 2: a bill/receipt floats behind subscription and expense lyrics; sharp emphasis for cancellation and the financial aside.
- Jazz break: original illustrated upright bass and saxophone with rhythmic movement and negative space.
- Verse 3: moonlit window, curtains, lamp and household silhouettes; amber replaces green.
- Bridge: return to the practical account motif with a warmer palette.
- Final hook: the number remains in the environment while human-value lyrics occupy the foreground.
- Outro: the account notification returns and resolves intentionally.

Bracketed performance directions are cues, not displayed spoken lyrics. Supplied wording is authoritative. Acoustic alignment and independent speech recognition are compared; disagreement must be reported, never silently rewritten. The scene timeline will use the measured vocal entrances rather than evenly spaced cuts.
